transcription_basis: Article Figures 2a/2b and 3a/3c visually inspected; SI pages 3-5 visually inspected. Products were transcribed from final drawings, not generated by a transform.

procedure.locator: Article Methods: General method for the synthesis of STAAR ionizable lipids
procedure.atmosphere: No inert atmosphere required per Results; Methods do not specify a gas.
procedure.workup: THF removed under vacuum; crude used for initial source screening.
procedure.control_purification: Flash gradient from DCM to 50% of DCM/MeOH/aqueous NH4OH 80/20/1.

source_conflicts: Results prose calls B2 unsaturated and B3 branched; Figure 2a and the SI identify B2 as 2-hexyldecanoyl and B3 as an unsaturated chain. Controls follow the independent drawings and named B2 intermediate, preserving the prose discrepancy.
SI page 4 lists experimental m/z 684.77 for A4B2C3; the later screening table lists 684.75. Neither is treated as high-resolution exact-mass evidence.
SI says seven purified derivatives but lists nine A4/B2,B4,B5/C3,C8,C9 combinations. This does not change the two individually identified controls.
nonclaims: No reaction registry or executable stage program is qualified by this transcription alone.
Product exact mass/formula and reactant balance must be checked independently before use as a program control.
Source biological measurements and candidate rankings are not imported as FORGE supervision.
No L2 route, full v8 family coverage, protected-precursor disjointness or training admission is established.
